tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po gnod sbyin tse'u dmar la bsten pa'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog log 'dren g.yul rgyal bzhugs so// bla ma dang dpal pad+ma dbang chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po gnod sbyin tse'u dmar po'i rten rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ru mtshon bca' ba'i thabs la don gsum ste/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum mo/ /dang po ni rgyu'i khyad par/ rab chu shing / seng ldeng stag pa la sogs pa/ ma 'byor na/ shol po/ lcang ma/ shug pa la sogs pa mdun shing 'dom gang las mi thung ba mtshal lam btsag la sogs dug khrag dang sbyar bas kha dog dmar por bsgyur bar bya/ gsom dben shing yin pas mi rung / glang ma 'byung po'i bla shing yin pas mi rung / thug lcags mi rta khyi gsum bsad pa'i lcags la dbyibs rtse gsum mam/ rtse mo gcig pa ral gri'i rnam pa can smad lcags sbubs su yod pa/ rtse mo me ris la sogs pas spras shing rno dbal dang ldan par byas/༈ dug khrag la 'bod rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags btab pas ngar blud la/ thug rnga rab 'brong rnga/ g.yag 'bras bu can gyi rnga ma/ rnga ma dkar dmar gyis bgyis tshe nag po kho na ma 'byor ba rnams la phan pa dang / dmar po ni 'di rang gi sku mdog dang bstun la/ don thob la ni nag po yin te ru mtshon/ 'di dag phal cher bdud kyi cha lugs yin pas so/༈ ma 'byor na rnga ma nag po gang yang rung ba rnams shing gi 'khor lo'i rgya gram la bsten nas mdzes par brtags/ gsung rten srog 'khor ni/ spu gri dmar po'i rgyud las/ de nas yang dag nges bshad pa gnod sbyin rang la bzlog pa na/ ras sam gro ga shog bu la/ /mtshal dang rgya skyegs dug khrag gis/ /'khor lo rim gsum rtsibs brgyad bri/ /lte bar 'bru lnga go char ldan/ /rtsibs la gtum po'i yi ge brgyad/ /mtha' mar sku mdog go char ldan/ /dam tshig gnad kyi snying po bri/

/zhes gsungs pa'i 'khor lo'i dpe ris zur gsal bzhin gyi lte ba dang / mu khyud kyi btags kyi bar/ dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po tse'u dmar po 'khor dang bcas pa ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ sgrub pa po bdag gi srung ma mdzod/ mi nor longs spyod bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod/ 'gal rkyen sol/ mthun rkyen sgrubs/ dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams la ltas dang cho 'phrul drag po mngon sum du phob la myur du tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig 'og nas 'byung ba'i 'bod rbad bsad gsum gyi mthar 'khor lo la bkod pa'i spel tshig dang bcas shog bu la dug khrag gis bris pa ci mang rnams mdung shing gi rtse mo la dkris pa dar sna dang tshon skud kyis mi 'chugs par bsdams pa lcags sbubs su bcug la gzer gyis bsdams/ sku'i rten ro ras sam shog bu la gnod sbyin gyi sku sor bzhi pa gri khrag gis bris pa la rab gnas tshul bzhin bya/ phyag g.yas nas rim bzhin 'phred la dril/ dar skud sna lngas dkris/ dar snas bcings la/ gri lcags sam/ snyug rgod sbubs su bcug la phyi nang la chas byugs/ srog 'khor kyang de ltar bcings la la ril bya/ drag po'i shing tsher ma can la byang bu mtho gang pa bcos pa'i ngos la 'bod rbad bsad gsum spel tshig dang bcas pa dug khrag dang snag tshas bris pa la la chus byugs/ thugs kyi rten du/ me long gi ngos su gri khrag dang sin+dhu ras hrīḥyig bris pa/ yon tan gyi rten du ras sam dar gyi khug ma'i nang du 'bru sna tshogs/ sman sna tshogs/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang ba/ phrin las kyi rten du/ gong gi shing byang / khrab byang mig dgu pa/ bse byang / stag ras/ gzig ras/ 'gron bu'i lan tshar dril bu/ g.yer kha/ mi mgo mi lag mi snying la sogs pa/ dar ras sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang /

'phan tshar ci mang / de dag thams cad gong gi rnga ma'i zhol chen gyi khrod du gdags/ de lta bu'i thug chen de gnod sbyin 'khor bcas kyi rten dang gtor ma legs par bshams pa'i mdun du/ mañdzi chen po la brten pa'am/ phyogs bzhir brgyang thag byas la bzhugs/ de'i mdun stegs bu'i khar gtor ma ni/ sras dul gyi gter ma'i lugs las/ gtor ma zur gsum rtse rgyan la 'khor zur gsum drug gis bskor ba byas la lug smug gam dmar ze'i sha khrag gis brgyan la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar bya zhing / mda' dar dmar pos brgyan/ de'i mdun du gsol kha'i chos kyi sha dum bu/ khrag chang phye mar/ mchod pa lnga la sogs pa rnams legs par bsham mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rnal 'byor pa dpon slob rnams kyi rta mgrin skyer sgang pa lta bu'i bdag bskyed sngon du btang nas/ ru mtshon la dmigs te/ zhi ba/ zhi drag phyed ma/ drag po rnams kyi sbyang ba khrus gsol dang bcas pa bya/ rten dang gtor ma rnams nang mchod kyis sbyangs la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ gtor ma mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las ā las ye shes kyi ka pā la stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i ri bo zag pa med pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod cing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ phyag rgyar bcas la ci mang brjod/ ru mtshon a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa'i rjes su/ kho bos brtsam pa'i gtor bsngo nas 'byung ba'i mngon rtogs sogs gnod sbyin 'khor bcas kyi mngon rtogs gang rung gis bskyed la gnas gsum byin brlabs/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug dam bzhag gtor bsngo mchod pa 'phrin bcol rnams/ gtor bsngo nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/ de nas rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba dang / mdun bskyed rnams kyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/

rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po tse'u dmar po dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ phyogs bcu'i gnas rnams nas byon/ mdun gyi nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab par bzhugs pa bsams la/ dar mdung mang po 'phyar/ rol mo rnams kyi sgra sgrog spos dkar dang sha chen tshil chen gyi dud pa sbyar/ dam tshig gi rdo rje dar nag gi g.yab dar bcas pa/ mi rkang dang shugs pa'i sgras 'bod/ rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin brtan po dang ldan pas/ rnga brdung shing dbyangs dang bcas te spyan 'dren ni/ sngags 'chang rgya gar bas mdzad pa'i bsang yig las/ hūm̐/ thugs rje tshad med zhing khams nas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol/ /rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings nyid nas/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /yi dam lha tshogs gshegs su gsol/ /gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol/ /dur khrod brgyad sogs phyogs mtshams nas/ /chos skyong srung ma gshegs su gsol/ /zhes dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i bskang gso las/ hūm̐/ phan bde kun 'byung zhes pa nas/ skad cig nyid la yud kyis gshegs su gsol/ /sprin ltar 'thib cing 'dir gshegs shig /glog ltar 'khyug pas 'dir gshegs shig /'brug ltar grags pas 'dir gshegs shig /thog ltar 'dril bas 'dir gshegs shig /hūm̐/ pad+ma dbang chen spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pas/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshegs/ /hūm̐/ dam can mkha' 'gro 'dul ba'i gnas/ /byin rlabs yon tan 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bde chen rol pa'i gzhal yas khang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /hūm̐/ sbyar ba'i spos dang g.yab pa'i dar/ /rnga chen sgra dang dung chen gling /

/rnal 'byor drag po'i ngar skad kyis/ /spyan 'dren ma thogs myur du byon/ /dam can rgya mtsho mthu rtsal can/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba rnams/ /gsang ba'i mchod sbyin rgya mtshos mchod/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'dus gyur cig /ces yid ma yengs par spyan drangs la/ oṃ rak+sha nas/ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi mjug tu/ oṃ e h+ye hi/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing / drag rol yun ring du byas/ de nas mtshan sngags kyi mjug tu gṛh+ṇa daṃ/ a pra tī ts+tsha swāhā nas shap+ta'i bar gyi mchod dang / sngags kyi mjug tu 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ ru mtshon la rdo rje gzungs thag dang dar btags pa'i sne nas rnal 'byor pa gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin gyis bzung / dpon slob rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ oṃ pad+ma tsan+dha ma hā kro dhā h+ya ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gnya' gnon ji ltar rigs pa dang / oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa snying la hūm̐ hūm̐/ shu la gh+ri wa/ tri shu la hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes bsnyen sngags sam bod pa dang / ā+oṃ mu sha mu sha dzaḥ tsit+ta tsit+ta sodaḥlceb ti thibs sod snying khrag dun dun/ tsan dza la ya/ srog rtsa la ya/ sha trūṃ srog la ya/ myur grir bh+yo bh+yo/ zhes sgrub sngags sam rbad pa dang / ya tri ya tri/ thuṃ thuṃ rbad/ tsa tri tsa tri rbad tsa la yaṃḥ tsa la yaṃ rbad/ dza la ya dza la ya rbad/ yaṃ yaṃ raṃ raṃ/ khaṃ khaṃ/ laṃ laṃ/ tri ya tri ya/ sha la kha ya/ snying la bh+yo thun bh+yo srog ru lu ru lu sha bla sha phaṭaḥ rlabs habs mugs ya rbad/ ces las sbyor ram bsad sngags rnams nyer gcig tsam re 'ur 'don bya/ de'i tshe rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs kha nas/ 'od zer dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ mdun gyi rtsi dmar 'khor bcas kyi sku la phog pas/ thugs dam gyi brgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba'i pho nya las mkhan nam mkha'i mtha' khyab par 'phros 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/

'khor 'das kyi nus mthu thams cad tshur 'dus mdun bskyed rnams la thim pas gzi brjid nus pa blta bar mi bzod pa khams gsum thams cad 'dar phri li li yod par bsam/ rnal 'byor pa gcig gam gnyis gsum tsam gyis gzungs thag sogs nas bzung / 'og gi bskul mi byed par 'bod rbad bsad gsum brtan par bzung / gzhan rnams kyis gsol ka bya ste/ de yang sngar gyi stegs bu'i kha'i gtor ma che ba'i g.yas su sha dmar po dum bu dgu dang / chang phud gtsang ma bzhag g.yon du phye mar dang / khrag chang bzhag mdun du las kyi rdo rje zhig gis lcags snod gtsang ma'i nang du g.yas nas sha re/ g.yon nas phye mar mtheb skyu re bcug gsol kha tshar re la de 'dra ba lan gsum gtor chen la bstabs cing / g.yas g.yon nas khrag chang kyang thig pa re blug rnal 'byor pa gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i bye brag kun thogs nas/ mdun gyi gtor rdzas la dgra bgegs kyi sha'i ri bo/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram khrod chen po stong gsum thams cad khyab par bsam/ de rnams tse'u dmar 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal dmar gnam sa tsam gdangs pa'i nang du sib kyis bstabs pas hab thob tu bzhes nas thugs rgyud zag med bde bas mnyes nas/ bdag gi bcol ba'i las thams cad thogs pa med par sgrub par bsam la/ dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ mgon po'i mtshan gsol gnod sbyin tse dmar che/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung bka' yi bya ra ba/ /gdug pa tshar gcod drag shul mthu rtsal can/ /bdud 'dul dpa' bo gnod sbyin 'khor bcas rnams/ /bdag cag rnams la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /'dod yon rgya chen gtor ma'i rgya mtsho dang / /longs spyod sna tshogs zhal zas mchod pa 'di/ /'phrin las mgon po tse dmar 'khor bcas la/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis mchod pa dam par 'bul/ /dges pa'i sems kyis mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /sngon gyi thugs dam 'phrin las nyer dgongs la/

/bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zhi ba dang / /'dod don mthun pa'i rkyen rnams 'grub pa dang / /thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas 'dur dbyangs bya zhing / hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po dmar po/ khams gsum dbang phyug chen po/ rgyal ba'i bka' srung dam pa/ lha srung yongs kyi ded dpon/ dur khrod kun gyi bdag po/ rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing / rnal 'byor kun gyi dgra lha/ bstan pa yongs kyi bya ra/ dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ bdud 'dul rnams kyi dpa' bo/ rmu rje legs pa'i sras mchog gnod sbyin tse'u dmar po/ lha chen dgra lha'i rgyal po/ gnod sbyin yang le ber/ kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ mna' zan kun gyi gshed ma/ gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi bdud pho khyod kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hī/ zhes brjod cing gtor bsngo nas 'byung ba'i gtor sngags dang / gong gi bsnyen sngags sam bod pa lan gsum rol chen dang bcas pas gsol kha dang po bstabs/ yang sngar bzhin bshams la/ gzhan yang yab rje mu rje legs pa/ yum chen gnod sbyin bzang 'dren ma/ gsang yum gangs dkar sha med/ bdud btsan nag po/ lha btsan dkar po/ brag btsan dmar po/ klu btsan mthu bo/ dri btsan mon mo thu ru rgyug dri btsan dmar po/ bdud 'dul gyi dmag dpung nyi khri chig stong / lha dmag bye ba dung phyur/ phyogs skyong zhing skyong / mdun gyi shugs 'dren/ g.yas g.yon gyi ru 'dren/ rgyab kyi rjes myul/ skyo sangs gar pa/ a tsa ra'i tshogs/ spre'u'i tshogs/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mchod pa dam pa 'bul zhing gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /rol chen dang / a kā ro'i sngags mang du bzlas la gsol kha gnyis pa bstabs/ yang bshams la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang bstan pa rin po che la dgongs te/

khyed rnams kyis dgyes shing mos pa'i stabs kyis bzhes la rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi nad dang gnod pa/ gdon bgegs thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ tshe dang bsod nams dang / dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par spel/ dbang phyug dang nus mthu bskyed/ snyan pa dang grags pa sgrubs/ dregs pa'i 'gro ba pho mo thams cad dbang du bsdus/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba rdul du rlog cig gzhan yang bdag cag rnams kyi rgyags chad kyi ma dang / blo lhag gi pha mdzod cig rgyab kyi slog pa dang / mdun gyi 'khar ba mdzod/ nyin gsum gyi bya ra dang / mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod/ yo na srongs/ 'gyel na slongs/ chad na 'thud cig ral na tshems shig stor na 'tshol la/ brjed na bskul cig mgo gang gi yar la bstod la/ dkyus gang gi mar la srings shig gzhan yang legs pa brgya dang sprod la/ nyes pa stong dang bsnol cig bsam pa yid bzhin du sgrubs la/ re ba rgya mtsho lta bur skongs shig mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol la/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog cig gnod byed kyi dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan la brtan par bzhugs te/ dgra dpung choms la bgegs dpung thams cad bshig cig dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon 'phyor cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod cig gzhan yang spo la dar 'phyor la/ khrom du dung bus shig gtam ngan rgyun chod la/ snyan grags 'jig rten du sgrogs shig dam chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha' la 'phyor la/ mtho ris dang thar pa dang byang chub sgrub pa'i mgon grogs mdzod cig skyabs dang / dpung gnyen dang / brten dang brling mdzod cig bdag cag gis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin bcol ba'i 'phrin las thams cad myur du sgrubs shig gong gi gtor sngags lan gsum la a kā ro rol chen dang bcas pas gsol kha gsum pa bstabs/

slar yang de 'dra ba tshang ma tshar gnyis te yongs dril tshar gsum rdzogs pa dang / 'di dag gi lhag ma lus pa rnams kyang bstabs/ de nas mnga' gsol/ dpang bstod rgyas par bya ba ni/ rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas pas kho bos brtsams pa'i mnga' gsol sogs mnga' gsol gyi yi ge gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/ de nas gzungs thag dkrol/ khrag chang 'thor ba la brtson pas/ mdun gyi srung ma rnams las pho nya las mkhan stong gsum khyab par 'phros nas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad thogs med du bsgrub cing / khyad par dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ sha khrag rus pa la sogs rjes med du bzhes/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drongs par bsam la/ gsol kha phyogs phyogs ma nas 'byung ba'i drag bskul lam/ kho bos brtsams pa'i drag bskul sogs bskul gyi rigs rnams byas/ de nas gnod sbyin 'khor bcas zhu ba las byung ba'i ru mtshon gzi brjid nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ 'phyar ba dang phyogs su gdengs pa tsam gyisadagra bgegs log 'dren thams cad char gcod pa'i nus ldan du gyur zhes brjod/ de lta bu'i ru mtshon de nyid gnod sbyin 'khor bcas la rten du 'bul ba ni rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas pas/ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha/ /dam can chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs/ /lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs bcas dgongs/ /'phrin las mgon po tse'u dmar/ /yab mchog dmu rje legs pa dang / /yum chen gnod sbyin bzang 'dren ma/ /gsang yum gangs dkar sha med ma/ /mched zla sprul pa'i btsan dug dang / /pho nya ru 'dren dregs pa'i dmag /sde brgyad bshan pa bcas pa kun/ /bdag la brtser dgongs rten la bzhugs/ /dur khrod 'bar ba'i ro thang 'dir/ /khrag mtsho 'khyil pa'i rba klong ljongs/ /dam nyams baṃ chen bsgyil ba'i khrir/ /brtan par btsugs pa'i ru mtshon mdung / /dpag bsam ljon pa'i srog shing rtser/

/rno dbal gri lcags mdung so la/ /dug khrag sngags rgod ngar dang ldan/ /lhab lhab 'bar ba'i me 'od can/ /g.yag rgod rog po'i rnga g.yab kyi/ /zhol chen sprin nag lta bur gtibs/ /dar nag ba dan 'phan rtse gsum/ /rlung gi bskyod pa'i 'phur lding g.yo/ /sku rten ro ras tsakli/ /gsung rten srog 'khor gsang ba'i sngags/ /thugs rten gsal pa'i me long dang / /yon tan rten du nyer lnga'i rdzas/ /'phrin las rten du dar ras 'phan/ /bse byang shing byang dam nyams kyi/ /mgo lag 'gron bu'i lan tshar can/ /dril bu g.yer kha sil sil 'khrol/ /phun tshogs rgyu las legs grub cing / /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs pa'i/ /thug chen 'bar ba drag po'i rten/ /rten mchog ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'di/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /gzhug pa'i pho brang chen por 'dzugs/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin sngon las/ /dngos grub char rgyun dus 'dir phob/ /dam can srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'du ba'i gnas dang rten du 'dzugs/ /pad+mo'i mtsho las ngang pa ltar/ /'bral med 'dus nas las kun sgrubs/ /dregs byed dmag dpung ru mtshon mchog /g.yul las rgyal ba'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bstan dang rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /sdang byed dgra bo rdul du rlog /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod kyi/ /srog shing tshe yi rten du 'dzugs/ /mi nor chos dang legs tshogs kun/ /rab tu rgyas shing brten par mdzod/ /de ltar ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'di/ /sngar bcol legs pa'i rten du 'dzugs/ /da bcol zhu ba'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bsam don 'grub pa'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /snang srid dregs byed gzhi bdag rnams/ /ru mtshon 'di la brtan gzhug nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bstan pa dang / /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyi/ /nyin mtshan bya ra mel tshe dang / /byang chub bar gyi sdong grogs mdzod/

/ces brjod pas mdun gyi bla ma yi dam srung ma rnams dang / snang srid dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud thams cad mtsho la char babs pa bzhin du ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan de nyid la thim par bsam zhing / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug khyed rnams ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag gi srung ma mdzod/ mi nor dgon gnas longs spyod bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod/ bstan pa dang rnal 'byor pa la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig nyid la tshar chod/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi srog la dbang mdzod cig ces lan gsum brjod cing / me tog gtor shis brjod kyi tshig skabs su gang babs brjod/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / nongs bshags/ brten bzhugs gshegs bsdu/ go bsgo/ bsngo smon shis brjod rnams skabs su gang babs ma 'khrul bar bya'o/ /de lta srung ma rnams la ru mtshon btsugs pa'i phan yon ni/ ru mtshon gyi rten de nyid gang du yod par/ dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams mkha' la sprin 'du ba'am/ mtsho la ngang pa 'du ba'am/ sha rul la sbrang bu 'du ba ltar gnas de nyid du rtag par bzhugs nas/ yul phyogs dge mtshan dang ldan pa dang / sgrub pa po rnams kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don thams cad sgrub par 'gyur bas tshul 'di la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes dpal 'phrin las gyi mgon po gnod sbyin tse'u dmar po la bsten pa'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog log 'dren g.yul rgyal zhes bya ba 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i mgon po'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog la gzhi byas gnod sbyin 'di rang gi khyad chos rnams tshad thub yig cha kha shas nas kha bskang zhing rang gis sngar brtsams gtor bsngo mnga' gsol drag bskul rnams kyang skabs bstun la sbyar te mgyogs par bris pa dge

yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa bsod nams 'od zer gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// ༈ /swasti/ tse'u dmar ru mtshon 'dzugs chog gi lag len zin bris/ thog mar mchod pa byin bslabs/ oṃ badz+ra nas tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa'i bar kho bos brtsams pa'i 'dul 'dzin gsol mchod kyi nang bzhin/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs bskyed chog dkyus 'gre la/ nang chu dang bcud sna sogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma dang nas/ dbu brgyan gyi bar du gang 'khod gsol mchod de'i mdun bskyed bzhin/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig kyang de nang bzhin/ rang gi snying ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba sogs kyai rdor bum bskyed bzhin/ 'on kyang lha la phog pas zhes sbyar/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma sogs brgya rtsa mchod bstod gong bzhin/ 'dod gsol ngang lha zhu tshul kyai rdor bzhin/ nas/ sbyong ba rgyun bzhin/ bden bdar rab gnas bzhin la/ kyai rdor gyi tshab tu bcom ldan 'das rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhes dang / deng 'dir gnod sbyin tse'u dmar po 'khor dang bcas pa'i nang rten ru mtshon 'dzugs pa la zhes sbyar/ khrus gsol rgyun bzhin la/ gang la ser sna ma rdzogs pa'i bzang khrus kyi mtha'i bkra shis mi dgos/ khyad par spyan 'dren gyi 'gor/ bcom rol bcom dung bskang ba thugs dam ma'i 'go bzhin/ thugs rje tshad med sh+lau ka gnyis dang / phan bde kun 'byung sh+lau ka dang por srin thung gi dbyangs rol/ phan bde kun 'byung gi mjug dang / hūm̐ yod pa'i 'go dang 'dus gyur cig rnams la tshig rol/ rjes ma 'dir chems brdung gsum brdeg len can rol skor 'bebs bcas phyi nang gi mchod pa la so so'i phyag rgya/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rang nyid yi dam du nas/ 'dar phri li li yod par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar yar blangs la/ oṃ pad+ma sogs nyer gcig
